plan: Drive: from Chilanko Forks, about 28 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.30728, -124.04768, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 68 m, about 109 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m N of the spot at 1,075 m (52.2703, -124.00851). Water: unnamed wetland 210 m N (estimate).
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2015 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-12, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-15, closures 2026-10-16.
R5C-deer-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-12: about 988 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.10 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
